title: Specialty Supply on Hand at an Expedited Approval (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, supply still on hand from the member's latest shipped specialty fill of the drug is added to the exigency period of an expedited exception approval, so that the exigency period starts counting covered fills only once that supply is used up. The fill is read from the member's Specialty Pharmacy Program records.

- *Days not yet elapsed:* the fill's days supply less the days from its ship date to the handling date, never less than zero.
- **Fill delivered to the member's home:** the days not yet elapsed are added.
- **Fill delivered to the prescriber's office:** only whole weeks of those days are added. That is the days not yet elapsed divided by seven, rounded down, and multiplied by seven.
- **Any other delivery location:** nothing is added.

The supply is added to the exigency period before the floor of one day is applied.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical fill of 28 days)

| Days since ship date | Days not yet elapsed | Home | Prescriber's office |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 23 | 23 | 21 (three whole weeks) |
| 22 | 6 | 6 | 0 |
| 30 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
